items.headline: Spectro Cloud Names Mike Gannon Chief Revenue Officer and Peter Finter Chief Marketing Officer to Lead Global Hybrid AI Expansion
items.excerpt: SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- #ai--Spectro Cloud, the hybrid AI infrastructure company, today announced the appointments of Mike Gannon as chief revenue officer and Peter Finter as chief marketing officer.
